scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --success first --names api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @design-atlas/web && npm run build --workspace @design-atlas/api
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test --workspace @design-atlas/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @design-atlas/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @design-atlas/api
